messages:
jen-support: FYI customer 'acme-data' opened a ticket — they saw a flood of 429s on /v1/embeddings yesterday 11:30-12:10 UTC after a backfill job. They claim ~2.5k requests/min and want a root cause + mitigation. Posting a sample error and headers we asked them for.

marco-sre: Can you paste one of the raw responses + headers (they might include X-RateLimit-*). Also do we have tenant-level quota spikes for that time window?

jen-support: Sample response from customer: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
Retry-After: 30
X-Request-Id: r-1a2b3c
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "message": "tenant rate limit exceeded",
  "retry_after": 30
}
```
Headers they reported: `X-RateLimit-Limit: 1200/min`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`, `X-RateLimit-Reset: 1670000000`.

alisha-ml: That looks like per-tenant quota exhaustion (not a platform-wide outage). Backfill jobs commonly spike token consumption for embeddings because of high concurrency and large batch sizes. Do we have per-route token counters by tenant in the dashboard?

marco-sre: We do, but the default panels are coarse. Quick checks I ran against metrics: `sum(rate(requests_total{route="/v1/embeddings", tenant_id="acme-data"}[1m]))` shows ~40 req/s sustained at ~11:31 UTC. `sum(rate(errors_total{code="429", tenant_id="acme-data"}[1m]))` matches that window. Looks like they hit their configured quota ceiling.

samir-cs: The customer said their backfill retried aggressively when they saw 429s which amplified the burst. They used a job that spawns 200 parallel workers.

marco-sre: For observability improvements I propose: add a 1m and 1h per-tenant panel for `requests_total` and `tokens_generated_total`, plus a 429-rate heatmap by route and tenant. Suggested PromQL examples for dashboards: 
```
# per-tenant request rate (1m)
sum by (tenant_id) (rate(requests_total{route="/v1/embeddings"}[1m]))
# per-tenant 429 fraction (5m)
sum by (tenant_id) (rate(errors_total{code="429", route="/v1/embeddings"}[5m])) / sum by (tenant_id) (rate(requests_total{route="/v1/embeddings"}[5m]))
# token consumption per-tenant (1m)
sum by (tenant_id) (rate(tokens_generated_total[1m]))
```

alisha-ml: Add a fingerprint field to attribution: `fingerprint = concat(tenant_id, ":", route, ":", model, ":", api_key_prefix, ":", user_agent)` so we can roll up repetitive bursts from identical job runners. That helps separate genuine traffic from noisy retries.

jen-support: CS asks for a quick mitigation we can offer the customer while we patch dashboards. They want either a temporary quota lift or a guidance doc.

marco-sre: For mitigation options: 
- Short term: increase tenant quota for embeddings by X (manual override) OR add a per-tenant short cooldown policy (e.g., exponential backoff enforced by gateway).
- Medium: add an automatic burst-detection rule that throttles purely-parallel high concurrency jobs (detect requests with same fingerprint and >N concurrent connections).
- Workaround: ask customer to reduce parallelism to <20 workers and add client-side retry with jitter and `Retry-After`.

samir-cs: I can offer them a one-off quota bump for 2 hours if eng approves. They prefer a quick lift so their backfill can finish.

alisha-ml: I'll add an alert and a dashboard card. Proposed alert (high-signal): `alert: TenantEmbeddingsQuotaBurst` -> fire when `sum(rate(errors_total{code="429", route="/v1/embeddings"}[5m])) by (tenant_id) > 0 and sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[5m])) by (tenant_id) > 10000` for 5m. That should avoid noise from transient single 429s.

marco-sre: Also add an alert for '429 fraction > 5% over 5m' with annotation recommending 'reach out to CS, consider temporary lift'.

jen-support: Repro steps for SRE/eng to simulate customer's pattern locally: 
```
# spawn 100 parallel requests to embeddings endpoint (use a small model)
seq 1 100 | xargs -n1 -P100 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"lorem ipsum"}' -w "\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```
This reproduces the parallel flood and should generate 429s if we throttle correctly.

marco-sre: I'll take ownership to run full traces and confirm if gateway returned correct X-RateLimit headers and whether our sliding-window algo is causing an unintended drop. @alisha-ml please push the dashboard panels and alert rule. @samir-cs hold the quota-bump offer until we confirm impact.

alisha-ml: ACK. I'll add panels: per-tenant 1m/1h request rate, per-tenant token burn, 429 heatmap, and a fingerprint-based scatter for high-frequency requesters. ETA 4 hours.

samir-cs: I'll draft the customer note: explain quota exhaustion, immediate mitigation (reduce parallelism or accept temporary bump), and longer-term options (dedicated capacity or scheduled backfill with rate limiting).

jen-support: Thanks team. Leaving this thread open until alerts/dashboards are up and we confirm the bump or permanent fix. :white_check_mark:
